name: smwmusic-mega-man-star-force
title: Mega Man Star Force 3 - Spade Magnes's Stage
description:
This is Spade Magnes's stage theme from Megaman Star Force 3, which is the first boss stage of the game. It certainly feels very final-like for a first stage theme, but I guess that's what makes it sound so good, haha

Other than that, this could also fit factories and castles in general, and even some more specific scenarios, if you want to as well. :V
